At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

For defence & mission support teams, these are the three workflows we would look at first:

Defence & mission support: where a pilot could start
  01: Routine supply administration
  02: Maintenance record completeness
  03: Contract evidence coordination

Our defence & mission support page puts it like this: “Coordinate routine supply, maintenance records and contract administration with explicit authority and a clear evidence trail. Keep administrative throughput moving without extending operational permissions.” For each workflow it sets out the request, the work, who keeps authority and the evidence that closes the case. There is also a calculator for putting a value on the time at your own case volumes.
